title: Typeless vs Willow Voice on Mac: Comparing Voice Assistants for 2026

description: Choosing between Typeless vs Willow Voice for your Mac? We compare features, privacy, and how Lazur offers a screen-aware alternative for your daily work.
intro: When you search for typeless vs willow voice, you are looking for a tool that turns your speech into clean, usable text on your Mac. Both Typeless and Willow Voice focus on dictation, but they handle your data and workflow in different ways. Lazur offers a third path by acting as a screen-aware assistant that helps you get tasks done rather than just typing.
tldr: Typeless focuses on high-speed dictation and multi-platform support, though pricing is currently opaque.
Willow Voice provides a structured dictation experience with a free tier and specific pro plans starting at $12 per month.
Lazur sits in your Mac notch, sees your screen, and guides you through tasks instead of just acting as a keyboard.
Choose Typeless if you need cross-platform support. Choose Willow Voice for structured dictation on Mac. Choose Lazur if you want an assistant that understands your screen.

blocks.text: How Typeless and Willow Voice Handle Dictation

Typeless markets itself as a high-speed engine for getting words onto the page. It claims to reach 220 words per minute. This is significantly faster than standard typing. It focuses on removing filler words and fixing your sentence structure in real time. It is a tool for people who need to dump ideas quickly without worrying about typos.

Willow Voice takes a slightly different approach. It uses what it calls Scribe AI. This feature tries to understand your intent. If you speak a messy thought, it aims to turn that into a polished email or note. It is less about raw speed and more about final output quality. It works in any text field on your Mac.

Privacy is the biggest differentiator in the typeless vs willow voice debate. Typeless claims to be private by design. It emphasizes on-device history storage and states it does not use your data for model training. It also holds ISO 27001 certification.

Willow Voice uses cloud processing for its primary models. This is how it achieves high accuracy. They offer zero-data retention on Business and Enterprise tiers. If you handle sensitive data, you must check their specific privacy settings. Always confirm your compliance needs before connecting these tools to your work apps.
Why Consider Lazur for Your Mac

Lazur is not just a dictation tool. It lives in your Mac notch. When you hold ⌥ ⌘, it looks at your screen. You can ask it where a button is. It will draw a circle around it. You can ask it how to do a task. It will guide you one click at a time.

While Typeless and Willow Voice focus on the text itself, Lazur helps you operate the apps you use. It manages your Calendar, Reminders, and research. It keeps your memory on your Mac. It does not click buttons for you, but it acts as a navigator for your workflow.
Typeless does not show its pricing on its website. You have to look for their pricing page, which may require you to contact them. This makes it hard to compare costs directly.
Willow Voice is transparent. It has a free tier with 20 Scribe uses per week. The Individual Pro plan is $15 per month or $12 per month billed annually. Team plans start at $12 per user per month.
Choosing the Right Tool for Your Workflow

If you need a tool that works on Windows, Linux, and mobile, Typeless has a broader platform reach. If you are a Mac user who wants a structured assistant that understands your screen, Lazur is the better choice. Willow Voice is a solid middle ground for Mac users who want a dedicated dictation assistant.

faq.question: Is Typeless better than Willow Voice for Mac?
faq.answer: Typeless offers high-speed dictation across many platforms. Willow Voice is more tailored to Mac users who want structured text and intent-based drafting.

faq.question: Does Lazur work like Typeless or Willow Voice?
faq.answer: Lazur is different. It is a screen-aware assistant. It helps you find things and learn how to use apps, whereas Typeless and Willow Voice focus on converting your voice to text.

faq.question: Which app has the best privacy?
faq.answer: Typeless emphasizes on-device processing. Lazur keeps your memory and data on your Mac. Willow Voice uses cloud processing for its models, with specific compliance options for business users.
